channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Kristi Noem out as DHS chief after immigration backlash
item.description: WASHINGTON >> Kristi Noem, who oversaw President Donald Trump’s aggressive immigration crackdown and faced bipartisan criticism in hearings this week over a $220 million ad contract, will leave her role as homeland security chief at the end of the month.

item.title: Britney Spears arrested on suspicion of DUI
item.description: LOS ANGELES >> Singer Britney Spears was arrested Wednesday night in Ventura County, California, on suspicion of driving under the influence, the California Highway Patrol has confirmed to Reuters.

item.title: GOP Rep. Tony Gonzales to end re-election bid after admitting affair
item.description: WASHINGTON >> U.S. Rep. Tony Gonzales, a Texas Republican, will not seek re-election, he said today, following calls from top House Republicans to drop his bid due to allegations that he had an affair with a former staff member who later died by suicide.

item.title: Honolulu police seek masked gunmen from 3 armed robberies
item.description: Honolulu police are asking the public for help identifying masked suspects in an armed robbery early Sunday near the intersection of Cooke and Halekauwila streets in Kakaako.

item.title: Wall Street closes down as oil prices spike
item.description: U.S. stocks closed down today as the Middle East conflict entered its sixth day, pushing oil prices higher and spurring worries about inflation and whether the Federal Reserve will cut interest rates.

item.title: Costco beats sales estimates as consumers seek value
item.description: Costco Wholesale beat Wall Street estimates for second-quarter comparable sales today, helped by resilient holiday-season demand for affordable essentials as well as “nice-to-have” items at its membership-only stores.

item.title: House turns back bid to restrict Trump’s war powers in Iran
item.description: WASHINGTON >> The House voted down an effort today to halt the war against Iran and force President Donald Trump to go to Congress for authorization, as a small bloc of Democrats joined nearly all Republicans in delivering an early sign of support for the war in the Middle East.

item.title: HPD: Human remains found at Mid-Pac construction site appear ‘ancient’
item.description: Human remains unearthed at Mid-Pacific Institute campus in Manoa during construction in late January have been determined to be ancient, the Honolulu Police Department said today.

item.title: California visitor, 76, rescued from cliffside off Kauai trail
item.description: Kauai firefighters airlifted a 76-year-old California man clinging to a cliffside after he fell about 30 feet off a trail in Wailua on Wednesday morning.

item.title: Rainbow Wahine clinch top-4 seed with 13th win in 14 games
item.description: Hawaii senior forward Saniyah Neverson scored a career-high 19 points on 8-for-11 shooting and the Rainbow Wahine basketball team extended their winning streak to a season-high seven games with an 89-56 win over UC Riverside today at SRC Arena in Riverside, Calif.
